name: Keycard Door Simplify Breach
teaser: Simplify doors without card selection, optional 100% breach success to any doors.
description:
SPT - Keycard Door Breach

A SPT BepInEx plugin for Doors:

  • Simplifies keycard doors by removing card selection, allowing the “breach” option directly.
  • Adds a toggle to force any “Door Breach” to have 100% success.
Only one checkbox in the F12 menu:
  • Enable or disable 100% Door Breach success.

How to Install

  • Download the zip package, open it and drag the ‘‘BepInEx’’ folder to merge into your main folder of EFT. The final DLL should locate at “Your SPT path\BepInEx\plugins\KeycardDoorSimplify.dll”
  • To uninstall, just delete the DLL file in that path.

Compatibility

This mod will downgrade keycard doors to normal doors, so any mod adding new features to doors will also happened to keycard doors (Like lock picking, sprint breaching)

Idea credit to Doors ClientMods by woohooFly on ODDBA forum.
